decisions.reason: Premium support sits at the core of the firm's promise of round-the-clock expert, agency-focused service, so management sees it as part of the identity it has publicly committed to and keeps it.
The version manager came out of the firm's own development investment and was presented on a dedicated page as an extension of its established toolset, so management keeps it as part of the platform.

Although distant from the core hosting offer, the contract tool is a low-cost, multi-model line the firm has already invested in and that supports its GDPR-conscious customers, so management keeps it for now despite uncertain fit.

Scalable agency hosting is the publicly announced flagship of the firm's direction and is backed by heavy infrastructure investment, so management would attribute any weak results to temporary causes and persist.
